Chapter 6695: I Shall Entertain You

Chapter 6695: I Shall Entertain You

Taichu differed from his previous lives. Moshi, Dingtian, and Poye all used different cultivation systems compared to Desolate Ancestor’s creation.

They were unique and didn’t spread this dao to anyone else. Even Weizhen cultivated using the regular system of this world.

Everyone else didn’t know the details about these dao, only that they were entirely different. However, Taichu chose the primordial tree as his dao.

After being born in the tree, some could argue he had surpassed Desolate Ancestor.

“Fellow Daoist, shall we spar?” Zhan Sansheng bowed and smiled: “I wish to know the answer, whether your pioneering or my dominion is stronger.”

“Your dominion is stronger.” She admitted: “But I shall entertain you.”

She was fearless regardless of the opponent. Others revered her for her unshakable spirit and will, compelling them to kneel. Since she was the founder, they respected her more than any immortal.

She paved the way for them to become immortals as well, acting as an eternal lighthouse amidst the ocean. The shore was ever-present due to her effort.

“I humbly disagree.” Taichu said.

“You might be a primordial immortal now but this only proves your innate talent.” A voice interrupted them.

Space rippled and someone else appeared amidst the battlefield.

“My Lord!” Supreme Black Ancestor became ecstatic.

“Young Noble.” Desolate Ancestor bowed, never forgetting how he permitted her to be close to the primordial tree.

Who else could it be but Li Qiye?

He glanced at the tribulation source and tossed it away. It pierced through space and time, disappearing from Three Immortals.

***

“Rumble!” The tribulation source landed in Heaven Realm next to someone.

“Shit!” The person jumped up, astounded.

He calmed down and said: “What a bastard, this geezer. I gave him a coin and this is how he’s returning the favor?”

“Don’t be angry.” A man with a shiny bald head stood nearby and smiled: “You’re older than him.”

“What the hell is he trying to do, damned him!” The first man pulled up his sleeves.

“I’m sure there’s a reason. He never misses the mark.” The baldy said confidently.

“He just wants me to suffer.” The first murmured.

“Perhaps there’s a solution, something big is happening.” The baldy scratched his head while having a serious expression.

“He’s up to no good again.” The first said: “I’m just a mortal enjoying my life, why is this thing here? Damn it, damn it all!”

“We have to find a way to seal it, I doubt running works.” The baldy said.

***

Li Qiye suddenly sneezed. He chuckled and murmured to himself: “A lot of bastards nowadays, ungrateful ones.”

“Sacred Teacher, I am eternally grateful for your permission.” Taichu came closer and bowed.

Everyone wondered about Li Qiye - a man respected by both Desolate Ancestor and the new primordial immortal.

However, even two primordial immortals couldn’t defeat him. Taichu stood no chance.

“It was your own effort.” Li Qiye said.

“Your magnanimity is beyond our reach.” Taichu said: “You created everything but never took the primordial will, giving me a chance to obtain an inborn legacy.”

Supreme overlords gained insight into this matter while Desolate Ancestor knew from the start.

Zhan Sansheng never considered them the final goal. His true enemy was Li Qiye.

He wanted to surpass Li Qiye so he created a unique dao each time. This was especially true when he was Poye, attempting to destroy the primordial tree.

Alas, the true form of the primordial tree was the primordial will - not something he could destroy. Only one existed in history, granting someone the potential to reach the high heaven.

All along, those privy to this information believed Li Qiye kept the primordial will in his body. Zhan Sansheng was one of them.

However, once he was killed and given permission, he was reborn in the primordial tree. He found Li Qiye not to be in charge of the primordial will.

It appeared illogical, even absurd, for Li Qiye to give his foe a chance to control the primordial will.

“It’s not something you can control just because you wish to.” Li Qiye said.

“Since you have let go, Sacred Teacher, I will overestimate myself and take up the mantle.” Taichu spoke with utmost confidence.
